name: Effect: sympathetic strings
notes: An effect for in front of any amp (another plugin or a real amp): no amp and no cab here, and auto_level off, so your guitar comes out at its own level with the strings' halo added. The strings are tuned to a guitar's open strings (E A D G B E); change Tuning in the chain editor for a drone in your key. All physics: nothing listens to what you play. Mix -18 dB: at the block's own 0 dB the halo came out 15.5 dB louder than the guitar (measured on the level riff).
